STRIKE.name: Strike
STRIKE.text: Damage equal to the dice it reads.

CLEAVE.name: Cleave
CLEAVE.text: Damage twice the pair's value. Deals half damage to adjacent enemies.

flawless.text: Adjacent enemies take the full damage.

CRUSH.name: Crush
CRUSH.text: Damage three times the matched value.

BARRAGE.name: Barrage
BARRAGE.text: Deal {hit} damage for every die in the straight.

OVERKILL.name: Overkill
OVERKILL.text: Damage equal to your total dice roll.

flawless.text: On a kill, repeat against another enemy.

SPALL.name: Spall
SPALL.text: Damage twice the sum of your two lowest dice.

flawless.text: Each low die also leaves a poison.

FURY.name: Fury
FURY.text: 4 damage for every die you rerolled this turn.

flawless.text: Increase damage by your missing HP percentage.

DETONATE.name: Detonate
DETONATE.text: Consume all target Poison. Deal 4 damage per stack consumed.

flawless.text: Apply half the consumed Poison to adjacent enemies.

APEX.name: Apex
APEX.text: Deal damage equal to your highest qualifying roll.

flawless.text: Double damage if that roll is exactly 20.

GUARD.name: Guard
GUARD.text: Block equal to the pair's value.

flawless.text: Every ally also gains half as much Block.

BULWARK.name: Bulwark
BULWARK.text: Gain Block equal to your total dice roll.

flawless.text: Also gain Retain equal to half that value.

AEGIS.name: Aegis
AEGIS.text: Block to every ally worth {share}% of the top of the straight.

BASTION.name: Bastion
BASTION.text: Block to every ally equal to both values of the house.

ANCHOR.name: Anchor
ANCHOR.text: 2 block for every die you did not reroll.

RIPOSTE.name: Riposte
RIPOSTE.text: Damage worth {share}% of the block you lost since your last turn.

flawless.text: Gain Block equal to 25% of the damage dealt.

SHELTER.name: Shelter
SHELTER.text: Give the weakest ally Block equal to twice the pair's value.

MORTAR.name: Mortar
MORTAR.text: Gain Retain equal to {share}% of your current Block.

MEND.name: Mend
MEND.text: Heal equal to your lowest die roll.

GRAFT.name: Graft
GRAFT.text: Heal equal to both pair values.

BLOOM.name: Bloom
BLOOM.text: Heal every ally 1 for each odd die.

flawless.text: Give each ally 1 Charged per odd die.

RENEWAL.name: Renewal
RENEWAL.text: Heal the top of the straight and Cleanse {cleanse#stack}.

LIFELINE.name: Lifeline
LIFELINE.text: Give each ally Lifeline equal to the matched value.

flawless.text: Lifeline also restores that much Block.

SAP.name: Sap
SAP.text: Damage worth {share}% of the healing you did this turn.

flawless.text: The party also heals for half of it.

SIPHON.name: Siphon
SIPHON.text: Heal the weakest ally for {share}% of all enemy Poison.

VENOM.name: Venom
VENOM.text: Poison equal to the pair's value.

flawless.text: Also deals half that value as damage.

MIASMA.name: Miasma
MIASMA.text: Apply 2 Poison per even die to every enemy.

CURSE.name: Curse
CURSE.text: Apply 1 Curse per rolled 1. Reduce enemy max HP by {loss} per rolled 1.

flawless.text: Deal damage equal to the target's Curse stacks.

SHATTER.name: Shatter
SHATTER.text: Remove Block equal to three times the matched value. Deal damage equal to the Block removed.

TITHE.name: Tithe
TITHE.text: Pyrite equal to the pair's value.

flawless.text: Deal damage equal to the Pyrite gained.

JACKPOT.name: Jackpot
JACKPOT.text: Gain Pyrite equal to the matched value × matched dice count.

LUCKY_SEVEN.name: Lucky Seven
LUCKY_SEVEN.text: Deal 7 damage and gain {pay} Pyrite per rolled 7.

flawless.text: With at least three 7s, receive the reward 7 times.

WAGER.name: Wager
WAGER.text: Spend {cost} Pyrite to deal your highest roll as damage. On a kill, gain twice the Pyrite spent.

flawless.text: On a kill, gain three times the Pyrite spent.

DOUBLE_DOWN.name: Double Down
DOUBLE_DOWN.text: Flip a coin: {odds}% the next gem is doubled, else it does nothing.

STAKE.name: Stake
STAKE.text: Spend {cost} Pyrite. Amplify the next gem by 50%.

APPRAISE.name: Appraise
APPRAISE.text: Appraise 1 raw stone in your bag. Deal damage equal to its value.

flawless.text: Appraise up to 2 stones and deal their combined value.

GILDED_ARMOR.name: Gilded Armor
GILDED_ARMOR.text: Gain Block equal to {share}% of your Pyrite.

GLIMMER.name: Glimmer
GLIMMER.text: Permanently raise each matched die face by 1.

flawless.text: Raise all faces of each matched die.

REFRACT.name: Refract
REFRACT.text: Add 1 phantom die copying your highest roll.

POLISH.name: Polish
POLISH.text: Adjacent gems gain 1 Clarity this fight.

MIRROR.name: Mirror
MIRROR.text: Change one die to join your strongest matching set.

FACET.name: Facet
FACET.text: Adjacent gems gain 1 Cut this fight.

ENRICH.name: Enrich
ENRICH.text: Adjacent gems gain 1 Carat this fight.

SEAM_RED.name: Red Seam
SEAM_RED.text: Every Red gem that has already fired this turn fires again.

flawless.text: Each of them plays a second time.

SEAM_BLUE.name: Blue Seam
SEAM_BLUE.text: Every Blue gem that has already fired this turn fires again.

flawless.text: Each of them plays a second time.

SEAM_GREEN.name: Green Seam
SEAM_GREEN.text: Every Green gem that has already fired this turn fires again.

flawless.text: Each of them plays a second time.

SEAM_VIOLET.name: Violet Seam
SEAM_VIOLET.text: Every Violet gem that has already fired this turn fires again.

flawless.text: Each of them plays a second time.

SEAM_GOLD.name: Gold Seam
SEAM_GOLD.text: Every Gold gem that has already fired this turn fires again.

flawless.text: Each of them plays a second time.

SEAM_WHITE.name: White Seam
SEAM_WHITE.text: Every White gem that has already fired this turn fires again.

flawless.text: Each of them plays a second time.

FIRE_OPAL.name: Fire Opal
FIRE_OPAL.text: Your other gems gain {heat#carat} for the rest of the fight.

flawless.text: And a Cut step with it.

DOUBLET.name: Doublet
DOUBLET.text: Copies the skill of the previous gem.

flawless.text: Also copies that gem's Flawless effect.

MATRIX.name: Matrix
MATRIX.text: Activate the first two gems that fizzled this turn.

ECHO.name: Echo
ECHO.text: Create a Void copy of the last gem that fired. It lasts for the rest of the fight.

NEEDLE.name: Needle
NEEDLE.text: +1 damage for every die this gem reads.

EMBERLINE.name: Emberline
EMBERLINE.text: 1 poison to the target when this fires.

GLINT.name: Glint
GLINT.text: Pyrite equal to the dice matched when this fires.

DUSTING.name: Dusting
DUSTING.text: Block equal to the dice matched when this fires.

VEIL.name: Veil
VEIL.text: This gem reads your lowest die as if it were your highest.

CATS_EYE.name: Cat's Eye
CATS_EYE.text: This gem reads every 1 as wild.

GRAINING.name: Graining
GRAINING.text: This gem counts held dice twice in sets.

ZONING_RED.name: Red Zoning
ZONING_RED.text: Counts as Red as well as its own color.

ZONING_BLUE.name: Blue Zoning
ZONING_BLUE.text: Counts as Blue as well as its own color.

ZONING_GREEN.name: Green Zoning
ZONING_GREEN.text: Counts as Green as well as its own color.

ZONING_VIOLET.name: Violet Zoning
ZONING_VIOLET.text: Counts as Violet as well as its own color.

ZONING_GOLD.name: Gold Zoning
ZONING_GOLD.text: Counts as Gold as well as its own color.

ZONING_WHITE.name: White Zoning
ZONING_WHITE.text: Counts as White as well as its own color.

FEATHER.name: Feather
FEATHER.text: The next gem in the rail is judged one Cut step better.

TWINNING_WISP.name: Twinning Wisp
TWINNING_WISP.text: Fires again if the gem before it fired.

FINGERPRINT.name: Fingerprint
FINGERPRINT.text: Carries one inclusion of the gem before it.

HALO.name: Halo
HALO.text: Neighbouring gems of this color gain a carat.

FRACTURE.name: Fracture
FRACTURE.text: Twice the strength, but it fizzles if any die shows a 1.

BRUISE.name: Bruise
BRUISE.text: Half again the strength; you lose 2 HP when it fires.

KNOT.name: Knot
KNOT.text: +2 carats, but it cannot leave its socket during a run.

VOID.name: Void
VOID.text: Takes no socket: it rides one beside whatever is set there and fires right after it. Fragile: cannot be sold or kept in the vault; shatters when the run ends, or when revealed at home.

CAVITY.name: Cavity
CAVITY.text: Its carats count double, but its cut counts as Poor.

FLUORESCENCE.name: Fluorescence
FLUORESCENCE.text: +1 carat for every depth below 10 while underground.

ALEXANDRITE.name: Alexandrite
ALEXANDRITE.text: Takes the color of whatever socket it sits in.

EVEN.name: Even
EVEN.text: Every face an even number, each one showing twice.

ODD.name: Odd
ODD.text: Every face an odd number, each one showing twice.

SPLIT.name: Split
SPLIT.text: The middle numbers are removed, leaving only the highest and lowest, repeated. Bigger dice repeat them more.

GAMBLERS.name: Gambler's
GAMBLERS.text: Every 6 and every 8 comes up a 7.

PAIRED.name: Paired
PAIRED.text: Half as many numbers, each appearing twice. Which numbers are picked when the die is cut.

STRETCHED.name: Stretched
STRETCHED.text: Every face doubled, so the die tops out at twice its size.

SHALLOW.name: Shallow
SHALLOW.text: All numbers are squeezed into the bottom half. It still counts as its full size, so every face is low.

WILD.name: Wild
WILD.text: Counts as any value, and as the die top for totals.

EXPLODING.name: Exploding
EXPLODING.text: Rolls again and adds, up to three times over.

SHINY.name: Shiny
SHINY.text: One Resonance more for every gem it helps light.

GOLDEN.name: Golden
GOLDEN.text: Pays pyrite every time it is rolled.

TALLY.name: Tally
TALLY.text: Goes up by 1 permanently each time it's rolled.

STICKY.name: Sticky
STICKY.text: Carries into the next turn instead of being thrown again.

TWIN.name: Twin
TWIN.text: Counts as two dice in every set.

DOUBLED.name: Doubled
DOUBLED.text: Counts as double its number everywhere.

LOCKED.name: Locked
LOCKED.text: Once it shows, the die cannot be thrown again this fight.

BLANK.name: Blank
BLANK.text: Has no value and doesn't count toward any pattern.

RUBY.name: Ruby
RUBY.text: Half again as strong on every red gem it helps light.

SAPPHIRE.name: Sapphire
SAPPHIRE.text: Half again as strong on every blue gem it helps light.

EMERALD.name: Emerald
EMERALD.text: Half again as strong on every green gem it helps light.

AMETHYST.name: Amethyst
AMETHYST.text: Half again as strong on every violet gem it helps light.

CITRINE.name: Citrine
CITRINE.text: Half again as strong on every gold gem it helps light.

DIAMOND.name: Diamond
DIAMOND.text: Half again as strong on every white gem it helps light.

OPAL.name: Opal
OPAL.text: Half again as strong on every gem it helps light, whatever colour it is.

GLASS.name: Glass
GLASS.text: Half again as strong on every gem it helps light. Each throw has a 10% chance to break it.

CRYSTAL.name: Crystal
CRYSTAL.text: +1 Resonance every time it's thrown, rerolls included.

IRON.name: Iron
IRON.text: Never rolls below a quarter of its top face.

FOOLS_GOLD.name: Fool's Gold
FOOLS_GOLD.text: Pays pyrite every time it is thrown.

GRANITE.name: Granite
GRANITE.text: Creatures can't break, blank or shrink it.

BLOOD.name: Blood
BLOOD.text: Rerolling it costs 2 HP. Its face goes up by 1 every time something dies.

ARDOR.name: Ardor
ARDOR.title: the Knight
ARDOR.text: The tank. Locks in early, heals for unused rerolls, and hits hard with three of a kind.

passive.name: Second Wind
passive.text: Heal Resonance for each unused reroll when your rail closes.

birthstone.name: Rally
birthstone.text: Almandine garnet in a shield cut. Sets of matching dice rally the Knight.
birthstone.face: Jaw set, eyes narrowed, a slow nod.

tiers.name: File
tiers.text: Three of a kind: deal three times Resonance.

tiers.name: Phalanx
tiers.text: Four of a kind: cleanse yourself and stun the target.

tiers.name: Legion
tiers.text: Five of a kind: deal five times Resonance, five times.

VESPER.name: Vesper
VESPER.title: the Rogue
VESPER.text: The assassin. Four d4s and a d20, betting on one huge roll.

passive.name: Riposte
passive.text: Gain Resonance block for every hit one of your gems lands.

birthstone.name: Thousand Cuts
birthstone.text: Black opal in a thin marquise cut, dark with tiny flecks of color.
birthstone.face: A thin smile, eyes on the target.

tiers.name: Thousand Cuts
tiers.text: Five different values, the top die outrolling the other four combined: deal Resonance damage once for every point on your highest die.

CADENCE.name: Cadence
CADENCE.title: the Wizard
CADENCE.text: The combo player. Builds straights and can make a whole turn fire twice.

birthstone.name: Encore
birthstone.text: Ametrine in a step cut, fading from violet to gold.
birthstone.face: Eyes closed, one hand raised like a conductor.

tiers.name: Overture
tiers.text: A straight of four: deal four times Resonance to every creature.

tiers.name: Encore
tiers.text: A straight of five: every gem that fired plays again, Overture included, and Resonance keeps climbing.

RUE.name: Rue
RUE.title: the Apothecary
RUE.text: The low roller. Wants 1s and low dice, and heals off poison.

passive.name: Leech
passive.text: Heal Resonance whenever poison damages a creature.

birthstone.name: Bitter Draught
birthstone.text: Dark tourmaline in a teardrop briolette cut, murky green-black with a bubble inside.
birthstone.face: A wry grimace, as if tasting it.

tiers.name: Tincture
tiers.text: Four or more low dice: poison the target for Resonance.

tiers.name: Draught
tiers.text: All five low: every poison on every creature ticks at once.

tiers.name: Dregs
tiers.text: All five showing 1: every poison ticks Resonance times.

PUCK.name: Puck
PUCK.title: the Harlequin
PUCK.text: The trickster. Flips dice between odd and even to line up the hand.

passive.name: Sleight
passive.text: Once a turn, shift one die to the opposite parity: even to odd, or odd to even.

birthstone.name: Motley
birthstone.text: Watermelon tourmaline, pink one half and green the other, in a checkerboard cut.
birthstone.face: One eye winking, mouth half grin, half frown.

tiers.name: The Cruel Face
tiers.text: All five dice odd: deal three times Resonance.

tiers.name: The Kind Face
tiers.text: All five dice even: gain three times Resonance block.

tiers.name: Full Motley
tiers.text: All one parity and all different, like 2-4-6-8-10: both faces, doubled, and the target is stunned.

FLORIN.name: Florin
FLORIN.title: the Gambler
FLORIN.text: The high roller. Has six sockets and turns pyrite into damage.

passive.name: House Money
passive.text: Each fight opens with a tenth of your pyrite on the table.

birthstone.name: High Roller
birthstone.text: Pyrite in a lopsided seven-sided cut, flecked with fool's gold.

tiers.name: Ante
tiers.text: Each crown: stake Resonance, and deal it.

tiers.name: Raise
tiers.text: Three crowns: match the pot from your bank, then deal it.

tiers.name: All In
tiers.text: Five crowns: go all in with your bank. The pot hits every creature and pays out the damage dealt as pyrite.

tiers.name: Bust
tiers.text: No crown: you lose the pot and take half of it as damage.

RAW_STONE.name: A Read Stone
RAW_STONE.text: An appraised stone from depth 4, ready to set.

PICK_STONE.name: Pick of Three
PICK_STONE.text: Choose one of three raw stones from depth 4, each a different color. It's appraised right away and can go straight onto your rail.

SOFT_ROCK.name: Soft Rock
SOFT_ROCK.text: The creatures in your first three fights arrive at half health.

HAMMERED.name: Hammered
HAMMERED.text: A random die is one size bigger for this run.

STEADY_HANDS.name: Steady Hands
STEADY_HANDS.text: +1 reroll every turn until the first landing.

COST_WOUND.name: A Bad Fall
COST_WOUND.text: You lose 30% of your health before you start.

COST_CHIPPED.name: Chipped
COST_CHIPPED.text: A random stone on your rail is one Cut step worse for this run.

REWARD_CARATS.name: Four Carats
REWARD_CARATS.text: A random stone on your rail gains 4 carats for this run.

REWARD_WILD.name: A Wild Face
REWARD_WILD.text: A random die has its highest face turned wild for this run.

FRAGILE_STONE.name: A Fragile Find
FRAGILE_STONE.text: A heavy, appraised stone from depth 20. It shatters when the run ends and can't be taken home.

STAKE_CARAT.name: Weighed Heavier
STAKE_CARAT.text: A random stone on your rail gains 2 carats for this run.

STAKE_CUT.name: A Truer Set
STAKE_CUT.text: A random stone on your rail is one Cut step better for this run.

REWARD_ALL.name: The Whole Rail
REWARD_ALL.text: Every stone set on your rail gains a carat, a Cut step and a Clarity step for this run.

CAVE_TICK.name: Cave Tick
CAVE_TICK.text: On a 6, takes one die from every player for their next turn.

SILT_SLIME.name: Silt Slime
SILT_SLIME.text: Splits when struck hard. Dies to many small blows.

QUARTZ_GOLEM.name: Quartz Golem
QUARTZ_GOLEM.text: Gains block equal to your highest die each turn.

MAGPIE.name: Magpie
MAGPIE.text: Steals pyrite when it hits and drops it all when it dies.

LANTERN_MOTH.name: Lantern Moth
LANTERN_MOTH.text: Its light gives everyone a reroll; each reroll drains 1 HP from every player.

VEIN_WRAITH.name: Vein Wraith
VEIN_WRAITH.text: Immune to poison. Takes extra damage from straights.

CLOUDER.name: Clouder
CLOUDER.text: Breathes a fog into one of your sockets until you strike it.

GLASS_WYRM.name: Glass Wyrm
GLASS_WYRM.text: Throws back damage from gems that fire at Resonance 0.

THE_FOREMAN.name: The Foreman
THE_FOREMAN.text: Warden of the eighth landing. Buries one of your sockets in rubble each turn.

THE_REGENT.name: The Mirror Regent
THE_REGENT.text: Mirrors half the party’s strongest last turn, up to 6 extra damage.

THE_DRILL.name: The Drill
THE_DRILL.text: Warden of the twenty-fourth landing. On odd turns it rolls your dice for you.

QUARRY.name: The Quarry
QUARRY.text: Old galleries under the workshop. Ticks and slimes near the top, golems and wyrms below.

SEEPS.name: The Seeps
SEEPS.text: Water finds every crack down here. Stones come up slick and dark.

GLASS_VEINS.name: The Glass Veins
GLASS_VEINS.text: Whole walls of crystal. The lantern comes back at you from every side.

WARRENS.name: The Warrens
WARRENS.text: Fungus over everything, and the air is thick with spores.

FURNACE.name: The Furnace
FURNACE.text: The rock is warm to the touch and glows along its seams.

GEODE.name: The Geode
GEODE.text: A hollow the size of a cathedral, lined in crystal from floor to roof.

RIFT.name: The Rift
RIFT.text: Below the Geode the rock stops making sense, and it does not end.

CUTTERS_WHEEL.name: The Cutter's Wheel
CUTTERS_WHEEL.text: An old cutting wheel, still turning. Hold a stone against it to recut it from scratch. The new Cut could be better or worse.

choices.label: Cut a stone again
choices.text: Rerolls its Cut from this depth's odds, tilted slightly in your favor. It always changes, and it can get worse. 4% chance it shatters.

choices.label: Leave it
choices.text: Walk on.

ACID_BATH.name: Acid Bath
ACID_BATH.text: A vat of smoking acid. It dissolves rock much faster than gems. It burns skin too.

choices.label: Dissolve an inclusion
choices.text: Pick a stone and remove one of its inclusions.

choices.label: Dissolve the matrix
choices.text: Dip up to three raw stones. Each one comes out appraised and costs you 6 HP.

CRUCIBLE.name: The Crucible
CRUCIBLE.text: Melts two stones into one. Only one comes out.

choices.label: Fuse two stones
choices.text: One of the two survives, heavier for it.

GEODE.name: Geode
GEODE.text: A round grey rock, heavier than it looks.

choices.label: Crack it open
choices.text: Three small stones 45%, one heavy stone 35%, dust 20%.

choices.label: Sell it unopened
choices.text: Get 25 pyrite. You never learn what was inside.

OLD_PROSPECTOR.name: The Old Prospector
OLD_PROSPECTOR.text: An old prospector offers to swap one of his raw stones for one of yours. His is heavier, but he won't let you look at it first.

choices.label: Trade a stone
choices.text: Give any stone, appraised or not. Get a raw stone up to 2 carats heavier.

SHRINE.name: Shrine of the Pattern
SHRINE.text: Rows of dice are carved into the wall, all showing the same pattern.

choices.label: Choose a pattern
choices.text: For the rest of this run, gems that fire on that pattern gain a carat.

IDOL.name: The Idol
IDOL.text: A carved idol with a cracked gem for an eye. It's set in deep.

choices.label: Work the eye loose
choices.text: Takes 1 to 5 pulls. Each pull costs more HP than the last: 3, then 5, then 7. The gem comes out appraised and Etched, with two Fractures.

ECHO_CHAMBER.name: Echo Chamber
ECHO_CHAMBER.text: A round room with a strong echo. Hold up a stone and the walls grow a rough copy of it.

choices.label: Echo a stone
choices.text: Pick any stone. You get a raw stone with the same skill. Everything else about it is rolled fresh.

COLLECTOR.name: The Collector
COLLECTOR.text: A collector who pays double for stones. She has one stone of her own for sale.

choices.label: Sell a stone
choices.text: Get twice its value in pyrite.

choices.label: Buy from her case
choices.text: Buy her appraised stone for twice its value. It rolls better than anything at a stall.

LOUPE_CABINET.name: The Dead Man's Kit
LOUPE_CABINET.text: A dead miner lies next to his open kit. The loupe inside still works, and the brass fittings can be sold.

choices.label: Look through it
choices.text: Appraise one raw stone for free.

choices.label: Strip the brass
choices.text: Gain {ore} pyrite.

FIELD_MEDIC.name: Rest Stop
FIELD_MEDIC.text: A nook in the wall with a bench, a cold stove and a supply box someone left behind.

choices.label: Rest
choices.text: Recover 25% of your HP.

choices.label: Resupply
choices.text: Gain {ore} pyrite.

TUMBLER.name: The Tumbler
TUMBLER.text: A rotating drum full of grit. A stone that goes in comes out with a different skill of the same color.

choices.label: Tumble a stone
choices.text: Rerolls its skill among the skills of its color. Carats, Cut, Clarity and inclusions stay the same.

SEAM.name: A Glittering Seam
SEAM.text: A seam of stones in rock too hard for your pick. You'll have to dig them out by hand.

choices.label: Pry out the big one
choices.text: Get a raw stone of better quality than usual for this depth. The sharp edge costs you 8 HP.

choices.label: Gather the chips
choices.text: Pick up two small raw stones that have already come loose.

SMITHY.name: The Smithy
SMITHY.text: A forge with warm coals, an anvil and a rack of files. Dice can be reworked here.

choices.label: Hammer a die bigger
choices.text: Raise one tier: d2, d3, d4, d6, d8, d10, d12, d16, d20, d24, d30, d40, d50, d60, d100. Its pattern is reapplied to the new faces. Etchings and material are kept.

choices.label: File a die smaller
choices.text: Lower one tier, down to a d2. Fewer faces means more matches. A d20 becomes a d16, and a d4 becomes a d3. Keeps its material and any etchings that still fit.

choices.label: Stamp the pattern
choices.text: The anvil is set up for one pattern. Pick a die and its faces are recut to that pattern.

CARVER.name: The Carver's Bench
CARVER.text: Chisels and etching needles laid out under a lamp. Dice faces can be recut or etched here.

choices.label: Raise a face
choices.text: Pick a die face and raise it by 1. There's no cap. A blank face becomes a 1.

choices.label: Recut a face
choices.text: Pick two faces on the same die. The first is recut to show the second one's number.

choices.label: Etch a face
choices.text: The needles are set up for one etching. Pick a face and it takes the etching.

VAT.name: The Vat
VAT.text: A sunken vat of glowing molten material. Dip a die in and it comes out made of something else.

choices.label: Dip a die
choices.text: The die takes on the material in the vat. Its faces don't change, but its old material is lost.

choices.label: Dip it blind
choices.text: Pick a die and it gets a random material. It could be any of them.

choices.label: Melt it down
choices.text: Resets a die to plain faces, 1 up to its size, with no pattern or etchings. Its material is kept.

ANNEALING_OVEN.name: The Annealing Oven
ANNEALING_OVEN.text: A brick oven on a slow burn. Heating a stone here can change its Clarity.

choices.label: Fire a stone
choices.text: Rerolls its Clarity. The result is always different. 4% chance it cracks.

choices.label: Push the heat
choices.text: Moves Clarity one step further from Clear, in whichever direction it already leans: Pristine toward Flawless, Etched toward Intricate. 4% chance it cracks.

WISHING_WELL.name: The Wishing Well
WISHING_WELL.text: A narrow, wet, brick-lined well. Throw something valuable in. The more it's worth, the better the reward that comes back.

choices.label: Drop a stone in
choices.text: Throw in any stone. A raw stone counts for half its value, and an appraised one for 1.5 times its value.

choices.label: Throw pyrite in
choices.text: Throw in anywhere from 10 to 1,000 pyrite.

choices.label: Leave it
choices.text: Walk on.
